requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model for relevance scoring input that includes a structured user_condition_intent field aligned with clinical_trials_models.py.
The system must define a Pydantic model for relevance scoring input that includes a list of trial_conditions using the same structure as clinical_trials_models.py.
The system must define a normalized relevance_score field in the output constrained between 0.0 and 1.0.
The system must include a contributing_factors field in the output capturing multiple factor objects explaining the score.
The system must include a confidence field in the output constrained between 0.0 and 1.0.
The system must enforce schema validation such that invalid or missing required input fields raise a validation error.
The system must support serialization of the relevance scoring schema to JSON for downstream service integration.
The system must ensure the schema is compatible with existing clinical_trials_models.py types without requiring transformation.
The system must allow contributing_factors entries to include factor_type, factor_score, and factor_explanation fields.
The system must allow the schema to be extended with additional scoring factors without breaking backward compatibility.
The system must handle the case where user_condition_intent is empty by returning a relevance_score of 0.0 with low confidence.
The system must handle the case where trial_conditions is an empty list by returning a relevance_score of 0.0 with an explanatory contributing factor.
The system must define field descriptions in the Pydantic schema sufficient for LLM interpretation of inputs and outputs.
The system must ensure field names and structure are semantically clear and unambiguous for LLM consumption.
The system must avoid nested complexity beyond two levels deep to maintain LLM usability.
The system must ensure all numeric fields include explicit type constraints to prevent ambiguous LLM outputs.
The system must include example values or schema defaults to guide LLM output formatting.
The system must ensure the schema supports deterministic parsing without requiring natural language interpretation.
The system must ensure contributing_factors explanations are short-form strings suitable for UI display.
The system must ensure the schema can be reused by downstream scoring logic without modification.
